markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier 1 frozen section: unanimous support [F1], severity-3 blur, all four margins positive [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, others 0% (ECE 5%, n=132) | High risk; small test set |
| Conformal set | {Invasive}, 90% coverage (alpha 10%) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliable, 100th OOD, 12/12 kept [F6] | Passes QC despite blur |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive (67%–70%) [F5]; InSitu 64% | Nearest neighbors all invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 2, 10) · ↑ invasive · Score +2.03 (+1.18) [F2]; 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.79, +0.80) [F3]; 20/20 spot check · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.22, +0.69) [F4]; 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.11, +0.38); 18/20 AI spot check · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful deletion test (+0.0114 drop, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197; all 12 regions 99%–100% risk).
- **Concepts**: Unfaithful deletion test (CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable mitoses, normal lobules, necrosis (0/20–3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 frozen-section blur may obscure ducts, mimicking invasion over InSitu (contrast BACH_0077, 64% similarity; AUROC 70%).
- Positive calls on all four borders (430–645 um) may reflect patch edges, not true margins; stains blocked.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 2, 10**: Check true mitoses versus blur artifact; mitoses concept failed validation (0/20).
2. **Regions 3, 5, 8, 9, 11**: Check invasion (3), pleomorphism (5, 9, 11), and scarce benign stroma/lobules (8).
3. **Regions 0–4, 7–11**: Check superior (645 um) and inferior, medial, lateral (430 um) borders.
